data.narrative:
Deep Atomic is a pre-seed nuclear energy company founded by William G.J. Theron operating within a sector containing 10 identifiable comparable companies: 3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 7 private peers including Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. The nuclear energy sector contains only 6 same-sector peers total, and applying stage-specific and valuation-tier filters yields insufficient datapoints—zero same-stage comparables, one adjacent-stage comparable, and zero similar-tier peers. The minimum threshold of three datapoints required for robust peer-median triangulation cannot be met. An all-sector median approach would introduce unacceptable noise given the specialized capital requirements and technology risk profiles in nuclear energy.

Without sufficient narrow peer coverage, quantitative triangulation via traditional comparable methods is not supported by the available data. A defensible valuation would require either: (1) expansion of dataset collection to identify additional pre-seed or early-stage nuclear energy raises with disclosed terms; (2) application of alternative methods such as cost-of-capital or discounted cash flow analysis with explicit scenario modeling, conditional on technology and regulatory assumptions; or (3) structured expert elicitation from domain investors. The sector's nascent funding stage and heterogeneous technology approaches (modular reactors, fusion, advanced fission) limit direct comparability even among the identified peer set.
